aka: She Put Away Her Heart in the Fridge

director.name: 克里斯蒂安·奥利维拉 Cristiane Oliveira

this_title: Ela foi ali guardar o coração na geladeira
trans_title: She Put Away Her Heart in the Fridge
introduction: In Porto Alegre, Brazil, Luiza receives videos from a stranger living in Uruguay. What seemed to be a mistake turns out to be a harsh truth about the past of Luiza's family: the woman has the same face as her deceased mother.
chinese_title: Ela foi ali guardar o coração na geladeira
